description: This file implements AES-CCM encryption and decryption functions for Bluetooth security, including cryptographic operations, nonce handling, and MIC calculation.

methods.name: xor16
methods.description: Performs XOR operation on two 16-byte arrays and stores the result in the destination.

methods.name: ccm_calculate_X0
methods.description: Calculates the initial authentication block X0 for AES-CCM.

methods.name: ccm_auth
methods.description: Performs authentication to generate MIC for AES-CCM.

methods.name: ccm_crypt
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption of message payloads using AES-CCM.

methods.name: bt_ccm_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using AES-CCM and verifies MIC.

methods.name: bt_ccm_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using AES-CCM and generates MIC.
